top_reviews.title: Beautiful pair of boots!

top_reviews.title: Got lots of compliments! 👢
top_reviews.text:
[[VIDEOID:60f3dd2cc6ecabe20028db5f599dbbb6]] I got these not thinking I'd like them because I've never been a fan of pointed-toe boots. But I am now! I REALLY liked how these looked on me and, apparently, lots of other folks did, too, because I received a LOT of compliments.

I ordered a size 7.5 knowing they might be too big for me as my feet hover between a 7 and a 7.5. 🥴 They were slightly too big, but I was okay with that. I just threw on a pair of thick socks (yes, I'm wearing them in the pics), and I got boots that fit great and warm feet on a cold day!

My feet did get tired wearing them after awhile, but that's probably because I don't normally wear heels. 🤷🏼‍♀️ I love that they just slip on and there's no zipper.

Overall, a great addition to my shoe collection!

top_reviews.title: Soft and flexible boots

The heel is enough height to elongate my legs for a dressed up look without being too high to be uncomfortable. The toes are narrow so may not be as comfortable for wider feet.
